title: OFM historian writer status
description: Payload of ofm/_system/historian/{runtime}: state of one runtime's historian writer and store-and-forward queue (ADR-0002). Published retained on every state change and at least every 60 s while buffering.

state.description: writing = inserts reach the database; buffering = inserts go to the local disk queue.

queueDepth.description: Rows waiting in the local disk queue.

droppedRows.description: Rows discarded by the disk-full policy (oldest first) since the runtime started. Anything above zero is an alarm.
